title: Extragradient and Past Extragradient Methods for $(L_0,L_1)$-Lipschitz Variational Inequalities
summary: Variational inequalities (VIs) capture a broad class of optimization problems central to modern machine learning, including min-max optimization and equilibrium computation in multiplayer games. Traditionally, algorithms for solving VIs, such as Extragradient (EG) and Past Extragradient (PEG), have been analyzed under the standard $L$-Lipschitz assumption. However, this condition is often overly restrictive, and recent works have instead turned to the more relaxed $(L_0,L_1)$-Lipschitz setting.
